titulo_fr: Un itinéraire modifié : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A modified itinerary: Vocabulary and forms
intro: He understands a change of transport and seeks the practical consequence for the journey. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: He understands a change of transport and seeks the practical consequence for the journey. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Attention: « À cause de » presents the cause; « donc » and « en revanche » connect its consequences. In this fragment, «correspondance» means «conexión».

frases.fr: La correspondance de 14 h 10 est donc impossible; un autre train part à 15 h.
frases.es: Por eso, no se podrá tomar la conexión de las 14:10; otro tren sale a las 15.
frases.en: So, you can't take the 14: 10 connection; another train leaves at 15.

frases.fr: Les voyageurs doivent consulter les écrans avant de rejoindre le quai.
frases.es: Los viajeros deben consultar las pantallas antes de dirigirse al andén.
frases.en: Travellers should consult the screens before heading to the platform.
